title: Insert into a Sorted Circular Linked List
description:
[Source: LeetCode 708 / GFG]
Given a Circular Linked List node, which is sorted in non-descending order, write a function to insert a value insertVal into the list such that it remains a sorted circular list.

Input Format:
First line: n insertVal
Second line: n space-separated circular list node values

Output Format:
Space-separated values of circular list starting from head
